plan.notes: Official Montclair State University 2026-2027 catalog page 'Biology - General Studies Concentration (B.S.)', 'Recommended Roadmap to Program of Study Completion' (120 credits; catalog prints Total Credits 120). This is a recommended plan to be used in consultation with an academic advisor and assumes no prerequisite coursework. Students must have a 2.5 overall GPA at the end of their first year and must have passed BIOL 112 or BIOL 113, CHEM 106 or CHEM 120, and MATH 122 or MATH 111. Major elective slots (21 credits): choose from the catalog's Biology Major Electives list; example options are shown with per-slot credit requirements. Per-term sums verified against the catalog's printed term totals (15/16/15/15/16/14/16/13 = 120). SEEDS slots are recorded as choice slots; specific SEEDS courses are chosen with an advisor.
